sections.subhead: Build a Multi-Vendor Platform Where Every Seller and Buyer Transaction Just Works

body.text: Teknoppy builds multi-vendor marketplaces in Kochi - platforms where many sellers list products, buyers check out once, and commissions and payouts are split automatically. We build B2B and B2C marketplaces, with an MVP typically live in 8-14 weeks from Rs. 3,00,000.

Marketplace platforms require sophisticated architectural layers that a standard single-seller ecommerce store never deals with — automated vendor KYC verification, split escrow payouts, multi-warehouse shipping calculations, and dispute handling must function reliably from day one.

items.title: Multi-Vendor Platform Architecture
items.html: Engineered for scale from day one. We structure vendor catalogs, unified multi-vendor carts, single checkout flows, and automated order routing to individual seller warehouses.

items.title: Vendor Management & Self-Service Dashboards
items.html: Dedicated seller portals allowing merchants to upload products, manage inventory, view live orders, print shipping labels, and track bank payouts. Need a supplier portal for your own company rather than an open marketplace? Explore our dedicated Vendor Portal Development.

items.title: Automated Commission & Split Payments
items.html: Automates transaction fee splits between the platform operator and vendors using gateway marketplace split APIs. Learn more on our Payment Gateway Integration page.

items.title: B2B & B2C Marketplace Workflows
items.html: Whether you are building a wholesale B2B marketplace with minimum order quantities (MOQ), tiered pricing, and credit terms, or a B2C retail portal, we tailor workflows to your market.

items.title: Ratings, Reviews & Search Discovery
items.html: Faceted multi-filter search, seller ratings, verified buyer reviews, and seller dispute resolution modules built directly into customer journeys.

items.title: Mobile Apps for Buyers & Sellers
items.html: Optional native or cross-platform Flutter/React Native mobile applications for on-the-go order management. Explore our Mobile App Development.

sections.h2: Built for Running a Marketplace in India

items.title: Vendor KYC & Bank Account Verification
items.text: Automated PAN, GSTIN, and cancelled cheque validation during vendor onboarding to ensure statutory compliance before any merchant can list products.

items.title: Automated GST TCS & Payout Reporting
items.text: Built-in Tax Collected at Source (TCS) deduction reports under Indian GST laws, alongside monthly platform commission invoices generated for vendors.

items.title: Gateway Split Payouts (Razorpay Route / Stripe Connect)
items.text: Direct node-level integration with payment gateway marketplace split tools, holding vendor balances in compliant nodal/escrow accounts until order delivery is confirmed.

items.title: Consumer Protection (E-Commerce) Rules Compliance
items.text: Mandatory display of seller legal names, country of origin, return/exchange terms, and grievance officer contact details on all product listings.

items.title: 1. Business Model & Revenue Mapping (Weeks 1-2)
items.text: We map vendor commission rates, listing fees, transaction flow, subscription tiers, and payout escrow schedules.

items.title: 2. Database & Multi-Vendor Architecture (Weeks 3-4)
items.text: We design scalable database schemas handling multi-vendor carts, inventory reservations, and role-based permissions.

items.title: 3. Seller Portal & Admin Development (Weeks 5-8)
items.text: We build seller onboarding portals, product listing tools, order dispatch dashboards, and operator administrative controls.

items.title: 4. Split Payment & Commission Testing (Weeks 9-11)
items.text: We run comprehensive live-transaction sandbox tests verifying automated gateway payout splits, refunds, and chargebacks.

items.title: 5. Vendor Onboarding & Go-Live (Weeks 12-14)
items.text: We assist with initial seed vendor onboarding, provide admin training, and deploy on scalable cloud infrastructure.

items.q: How much does it cost to build a marketplace in Kochi?
items.a: A multi-vendor marketplace MVP typically costs ₹3,00,000 to ₹8,00,000+, depending on vendor onboarding complexity, commission calculation rules, split escrow payouts, and third-party logistics integrations. Delivery takes 8 to 14 weeks.

items.q: How can a marketplace platform make money?
items.a: Marketplaces typically generate revenue through a percentage commission on each successful sale, fixed listing fees, monthly vendor subscription tiers, sponsored featured product placements, or fulfillment and payment processing markups.

items.q: Can the marketplace have native mobile apps for buyers and sellers?
items.a: Yes. We build responsive web platforms first and develop native iOS and Android apps using Flutter or React Native, providing push notifications, seller barcode scanning, and instant buyer checkout.

items.q: What is the difference between a marketplace and a regular ecommerce store?
items.a: A standard store sells products from one single company. A marketplace hosts multiple independent merchants selling to a shared customer base, requiring vendor onboarding, commission deduction logic, split payouts, and vendor-specific order fulfillment.

items.q: Can vendors manage their own product listings and orders?
items.a: Yes. Each vendor gets a dedicated self-service dashboard to add products, adjust stock, print shipping labels, review customer ratings, and track bank account payouts independently.

items.q: How does commission and payment splitting actually work in India?
items.a: When a customer completes checkout, the payment is processed through a gateway marketplace product like Razorpay Route or Stripe Connect. The platform commission is automatically deducted, and vendor shares are held in compliant nodal accounts until order delivery is verified before release.
